sāmaṇera.cp: masc. a novice of a monk.
sāmaṇera.p: [ samaṇa + ṇera. Samaṇassa apaccaṃ sāmaṇero. Kaccaññaḥ. 349. Nīti, sutta. 758. Dhāna, ṭī. 440. Samaṇassa upajcyāyassa putto (puttaṭṭhā-niyattāti) sāmaṇe ro. Rū. 372. Nirutti. 434. Samaṇa + īra + ṇa. Samaṇehi īretabbo pavattetabbotipi sāmaṇe-ro. Rū, ṭī. 372. ၐramaṇera- sakkata-piṭaka. (pu) sāmaṇe-pākata. Thī-၌ sāmaṇerī. ] (thī, pu) Google Translate Novice Korin Maung Shin.
